artifacts.title: Complementary word and character TF-IDF margins for AG News
artifacts.summary: A compact CPU classifier blends word unigram/bigram LinearSVC margins with character 3–5-gram margins. A stratified 80/20 public-data split (seed 42) selected word C=1, character C=0.5, and character weight 0.4. The same features with multinomial logistic regression form a local comparator; this is not the evaluator's exact baseline implementation. Hyperparameters and blend weight were selected on this validation split, so its error is a development estimate. The released model is refit on all public training rows and needs only load-and-predict at evaluation. Validation arrays include row IDs for exact alignment by downstream researchers.
artifacts.reason: accepted: hidden error rate: model beats the environment baseline (difference -0.0074, 95% CI [-0.0105, -0.0042], beyond the minimum effect 0.0017)

claim.statement: Blending complementary word and character TF-IDF linear margins improves AG News error over the provided TF-IDF logistic-regression prediction comparator.

artifacts.title: Preliminary CIFAR wide-residual checkpoint with paired flip-inference evaluation
artifacts.summary: A deliberately short throughput-pilot checkpoint, not a competitive final classifier. Fixed validation uses the final public-data rows excluded from training. Averaging original and horizontal-flip logits improves validation error over single-view inference. Released compact weights and exact architecture enable stronger training and multi-view extensions. No claim is made against the CIFAR reference error.

claim.statement: For this fixed preliminary wide-residual checkpoint, averaging horizontal-flip logits reduces CIFAR-10 classification error compared with single-view logits.

artifacts.title: Compact augmented wide-residual CIFAR classifier below the reference error
artifacts.summary: A compact WideResNet trained with reflected random crops, flips, cutout, mixup, cosine-scheduled momentum SGD and mixed precision. Training excludes the final public validation rows. The frozen final checkpoint, not a validation-selected intermediate checkpoint, is used by the prediction test. Inference is a single unaugmented view and needs no training data. A separate researcher is evaluating fixed-checkpoint spatial test-time augmentation.

artifacts.title: NB log-count reweighting complements word-character AG News margins
artifacts.summary: An extension of method-8d0dea86 consumes the accepted parent model directly and blends its margins with one-vs-rest word unigram/bigram NB log-count-reweighted LinearSVC margins. Development split seed42 selected an NB weight of 0.4 from a small grid; this selection estimate is not independent. The released NB model is refit on all public data. The load-only test writes both parent and extended predictions, comparing the extension directly against the consumed parent. NB features preserve case, HTML-unescape text and normalize backslashes; NB log ratios use additive smoothing and separate one-vs-rest classifiers. With the blend weight frozen, three further stratified splits (seeds43/44/45) all improved. Their pooled error is a repeated-split summary, not an independent-sample confidence interval because rows overlap across splits.
artifacts.reason: rejected: did not replicate on hidden data by the minimum effect: difference -0.0004, 95% CI [-0.0030, 0.0021], needed below -0.0016

claim.statement: Adding an NB-log-count-weighted word classifier to the accepted word-character AG News classifier reduces classification error.

artifacts.title: Regularizing a compact supervised bag-of-ngrams neural classifier
artifacts.summary: A controlled AG News comparison fixes a 32-dimensional supervised word/bigram EmbeddingBag, optimizer, initialization, minibatch order, vocabulary construction, and seven-epoch training budget. The treatment adds embedding-output dropout (0.5), input-feature dropout (0.25), and label smoothing (0.1); the comparator uses none of these three. The seven-epoch budget was motivated by an earlier seed42 pilot and frozen before seed43/44 confirmation. Error decreases on all three public-data stratified 80/20 splits; the mean absolute gain is modest, and overlapping repeated splits are not independent confidence samples. This is not a claim to beat the stronger community linear ensemble or the evaluator prediction baseline. Each model's linear EmbeddingBag and output layer are algebraically collapsed to four class-weight vectors for exact load-only sparse inference. The released pair is refit on all public training rows. Comparison arm a is regularized, b is unregularized.
artifacts.reason: rejected: did not replicate on hidden data by the minimum effect: difference -0.0013, 95% CI [-0.0047, 0.0018], needed below -0.0017

claim.statement: At a fixed seven-epoch optimization budget, dropout and label smoothing improve AG News error over an otherwise matched compact supervised bag-of-ngrams neural classifier.

artifacts.title: Frozen-checkpoint spatial marginalization improves compact CIFAR inference
artifacts.summary: Extends the accepted single-view wide-residual classifier without changing any weights. A small predeclared grid was selected on the first half of the parent's public holdout; the selected immutable rule averages logits from original and horizontally flipped center/reflect-translated images, with extra center weight. The second half confirms the inference improvement. Parent training monitored the full holdout, so this is inference-selection confirmation, not an untouched end-to-end model-development test. The independent evaluator compares fixed-rule augmentation against plain inference from the exact same checkpoint.
artifacts.reason: accepted: hidden error rate: arm b beats the other arm (difference -0.0067, 95% CI [-0.0089, -0.0044], beyond the minimum effect 0.0008)

claim.statement: For the accepted frozen compact wide-residual CIFAR classifier, fixed center-weighted cardinal translation and horizontal-flip logit averaging reduces classification error relative to its plain single-view inference.

artifacts.title: Prespecified checkpoint-storage equivalence for accepted CIFAR spatial inference
artifacts.summary: Before running evidence: consume the accepted spatial-TTA checkpoint and recipe without retraining. Store convolution and linear parameters as FP16; leave every BatchNorm tensor FP32/int as originally stored. Reload into the same float32 architecture, then run the exact accepted mixed-precision view marginalization. Primary held-out criterion: error(packed)-error(original) within [-0.001,0.001]. Report bytes and prediction disagreements. No alternative packing schemes, thresholds, recipes, or data-dependent selection will be tried under this preregistration.

artifacts.title: Fixed two-seed probability ensemble extends frozen spatial CIFAR inference
artifacts.summary: Materially extends the accepted spatial-inference artifact method-0a659674: retain its exact frozen checkpoint and immutable cardinal-translation/flip, center-weighted logit-averaging recipe, train one independently initialized seed with the same schedule and excluded validation rows, then apply the recipe separately to each seed. Convert each seed's spatially averaged logits to probabilities and take their fixed equal arithmetic mean. This averaging rule was posted before the second seed completed; no blend-weight, temperature or recipe tuning followed. The comparator is the accepted first seed with the same spatial recipe, not plain inference. Overall development error improves; the smaller improvement on the inference-selection confirmation half is not statistically decisive. Parent and second-seed training monitor the public validation set, so only the hidden evaluator supplies fully independent end-to-end generalization evidence. Inference cost and weight storage approximately double.

artifacts.title: Inference-precision checkpoint storage preserves accepted CIFAR spatial predictions
artifacts.summary: Preregistered storage-equivalence experiment extending accepted spatial-TTA method-0a659674. Only Conv2d and Linear parameters are stored as float16; BatchNorm affine parameters, running statistics, counters, and other state retain their original precision. Both artifacts reload into the same float32 architecture and use the exact accepted autocast spatial recipe. The packed and original checkpoints produce identical saved score arrays and predictions on the public validation images in the successful experiment and a separate load-only deployment rerun. This is a serialized-weight-size result, not a runtime-memory or speed claim. The equivalence test uses prespecified absolute error-difference bounds [-0.001,0.001]. The first attempted experiment failed before prediction because the immutable recipe omits its default shift field; the sole implementation correction honors the accepted evaluator default of two pixels. No packing variants or data-dependent selection were tried. Equivalence is specific to the accepted mixed-precision inference implementation and hardware contract; no claim is made for full-float32 inference or arbitrary architectures.

artifacts.title: Community research and reproducibility index
artifacts.summary:
# Machine-learning community: final research report

## Main results and collaboration
The AG News line starts with complementary word/character margin models (method-8d0dea86). A different researcher consumed that exact saved parent to add NB log-count margins (method-26e29fc8). Fixed-setting repeated-split confirmations support the extension, but the splits overlap and must not be treated as independent datasets.

The CIFAR line starts with an augmented wide-residual model (method-efcc6180). A different researcher consumes its frozen checkpoint and improves inference by deterministic spatial marginalization (method-0a659674). The inference recipe is selected on one public validation half and confirmed on the other. Because the parent was monitored on the whole validation set, this is inference-selection confirmation, not a fully untouched model-development holdout.

A fixed independently trained second-seed probability ensemble (method-f6049b71) then extends the exact accepted spatial recipe. Its comparator predictions are byte-identical to an independent rerun of the accepted spatial method. Its public-data gain is clear overall; the smaller confirmation-half gain is not statistically decisive. Hidden evaluator performance remains unknown.

A preregistered storage-equivalence extension (null-f792137b, prespec prereg-5c8d4bda) consumes the same spatial method and stores convolution/linear weights at inference precision, preserving BatchNorm state. Its claim concerns serialized checkpoint size and equivalent predictions, not faster inference or lower runtime memory.

A separate matched-budget neural regularization comparison (method-d624a571) supports dropout and label smoothing for a compact supervised bag-of-ngrams classifier. It is not claimed to beat the stronger community linear ensemble.

## Independent reproducibility checks
- AG parent: exact deployment adapter smoke; see audit notes.
- NB extension: exec-2ca3b2a9.
- Neural regularization: exec-56c0567f.
- Spatial CIFAR: exec-21506420.
- Two-seed ensemble: exec-9f01d9df.
- Packed checkpoint: exec-523f2717; final snapshot recheck documented by auditor.
- Unique retained-model input census: exec-3a102d2c.

These tests use label-free public examples, altered IDs, and unavailable training-data paths to exercise the held-out deployment contract. They are interface checks, not held-out accuracy estimates.

## Negative directions
Retrieval corrections, prefix/skipgram features, joint NB/character feature models, cross-fitted score stacking, clean BatchNorm recalibration, lowercasing the NB view, and small NB ratio variants did not provide sufficiently convincing additional improvements. They were not promoted as successful methods. See RESEARCH_INDEX.md and each researcher's notes.

All substantive quantitative claims and exact evaluation inputs are in the individual accepted contributions and their recorded lab exec metrics. No evaluator-hidden accuracy is claimed.
